title.fa: مسخ کافکا: هویتِ نان‌آور و فشار کار
title.en: Kafka's Metamorphosis: the breadwinner's identity and the pressure of work
title.nl: Kafka's Metamorfose: de identiteit van de kostwinner en werkdruk

summary.fa: در روایت کافکا، گرگور سامسا پیش از دگرگونی‌اش کاملاً با نقشِ نان‌آور تعریف می‌شود. نخستین نگرانی‌اش پس از بیدار شدن نه بدنِ تازه، بلکه دیر رسیدن به قطار و واکنش مافوق است. این مدخل برداشتی ادبی از متن است، نه گزارش واقعیت.
summary.en: In Kafka's story Gregor Samsa is defined by his role as breadwinner. On waking, his first worry is not his new body but the missed train and his superiors' reaction. This is a literary reading of the text, not a factual report.
summary.nl: In Kafka's verhaal wordt Gregor Samsa bepaald door zijn rol als kostwinner; zijn eerste zorg is de gemiste trein, niet zijn nieuwe lichaam.

text.fa: گرگور فروشندهٔ دوره‌گردِ پارچه است و در همان ساعت‌های اول از کارش گله می‌کند: سفرهای پیاپی، عوض‌کردن قطار، غذای بد و آدم‌هایی که هرگز دوباره نمی‌بیندشان.
text.en: Gregor is a travelling cloth salesman who, within the first hour, complains about his job: constant travel, changing trains, bad meals and people he will never meet again.
text.nl: Gregor is a travelling cloth salesman who, within the first hour, complains about his job: constant travel, changing trains, bad meals and people he will never meet again.

text.fa: او خود را به‌خاطر بدهیِ خانواده به رئیس به کار بسته می‌داند و فکر می‌کند اگر این قید نبود، مدت‌ها پیش کنار گذاشته بود؛ برآورد خودش پنج یا شش سال دیگر است.
text.en: He sees himself bound to the firm by his family's debt to the boss, and thinks that without it he would have quit long ago; by his own estimate, five or six more years.
text.nl: He sees himself bound to the firm by his family's debt to the boss, and thinks that without it he would have quit long ago; by his own estimate, five or six more years.

text.fa: معاونِ شرکت به در خانه می‌آید تا غیبتش را بازخواست کند و در همان گفتار هم تهدید و هم گلایه از عملکرد اخیر او را پیش می‌کشد؛ کافکا شک‌آلودگیِ نظامِ کار را با همین صحنه نشان می‌دهد.
text.en: The firm's chief clerk comes to the home to question his absence, mixing reproach and a hint of threat about his recent performance; the scene shows the suspicion built into this workplace.
text.nl: The firm's chief clerk comes to the home to question his absence, mixing reproach and a hint of threat about his recent performance; the scene shows the suspicion built into this workplace.

text.fa: گرگور حتی در هیئت حشره، با خطابهٔ طولانی از پشت در می‌کوشد موقعیت شغلی‌اش را نجات دهد و می‌گوید خرجِ پدر و مادر و خواهرش بر دوش اوست.
text.en: Even as an insect, speaking from behind the door he tries to rescue his job, stressing that he supports his parents and sister.
text.nl: Even as an insect, speaking from behind the door he tries to rescue his job, stressing that he supports his parents and sister.

text.fa: تفسیرهای دانشگاهی دربارهٔ این داستان یکی نیستند؛ خوانش «از‌خودبیگانگیِ کار»، خوانش خانوادگی-روان‌کاوانه و خوانش دربارهٔ گناه و بوروکراسی همه رایج‌اند و داستان خود تفسیر نمی‌دهد.
text.en: Academic readings of the story differ: alienated labour, family/psychoanalytic, and guilt/bureaucracy readings are all common; the text itself offers no interpretation.
text.nl: Academic readings of the story differ: alienated labour, family/psychoanalytic, and guilt/bureaucracy readings are all common; the text itself offers no interpretation.
